A political map of West Africa showing the 15 ECOWAS member states. Each country is clearly outlined and labelled with its name. The landlocked countries (Mali, Niger, Burkina Faso) are shaded in a light yellow, the coastal Francophone and Lusophone countries in light green, and the Anglophone countries (Nigeria, Ghana, Sierra Leone, Liberia, The Gambia) in a pale orange. Cape Verde is visible as an island group to the west. A compass rose and scale are included.
